page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated virtual CPUs spanning 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates hardware instruction support for AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with standard AES encryption acceleration.

System memory consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark evaluations place memory throughput in the middle 50% category, showing 779.61 GB/sec for small cached 16 KB read blocks, 89.18 GB/sec for large uncached 256 MB reads, and 46.34 GB/sec for 256 MB writes. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating network-attached block storage for persistence. Dedicated network bandwidth baseline is rated at 5 Gbps, and no accelerators or GPUs are bundled.

Benchmark results highlight solid mid-tier computational scaling with modest single-core throughput. Single-threaded metrics, including stress-ng single-core (1310.38) and single-threaded gzip compression (22.76 GB/sec), perform in the bottom 25% percentile. In contrast, multi-threaded tasks demonstrate standard mid-range output, characterized by a PassMark CPU score of 15,381.15, a Geekbench multi-core score of 7,205.0, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 67.67 GB/sec. Application tests show dependable execution with Redis SET operations sustaining 13.43 million operations per second and static web throughput measuring 11.32 GB/sec.

This hardware balance provides steady computational density for multi-threaded enterprise services without incurring premium GPU or specialized hardware costs. Due to the lack of bundled local NVMe storage and subdued single-threaded velocity, workloads demanding extreme single-core clocks or ultra-low storage latency may require different configurations. The instance is best suited for balanced production environments, including mid-tier relational databases, enterprise web serving, microservices architectures, and distributed continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs on an 8-core Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of RAM. Operating on a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, the system integrates AVX-512 vector support and 5 Gbps baseline network throughput, with no bundled local storage or GPUs. Benchmark evaluation reveals steady middle-tier multi-threaded processing, reflected in a PassMark CPU score of 15,381.15 and multi-core Geekbench score of 7,205.0, whereas single-core stress testing settles in the lower quartile. Memory throughput is solid across cached and uncached blocks, sustaining 13.43 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.32 GB/sec in static web serving. The instance presents a standard resource profile suited for enterprise application backends, containerized workloads, distributed CI/CD pipelines, and general business databases requiring external storage.
